title: Spread out finite-type nearby-cycle input to an arithmetic base
statement: Let $S$ be integral affine Noetherian, $f:X\to S$ of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], $\Lambda$ finite with $m\Lambda=0$ and $m$ invertible on $S$, and $K\in D^b(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ have constructible cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. There exist an integral affine scheme $S_0$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z[1/m]$, a dominant map $a:S\to S_0$, a finite-type morphism $f_0:X_0\to S_0$, and $K_0\in D^b_c(X_{0,\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$, with $X\simeq X_0\times_{S_0}S$ and $K\simeq a_X^*K_0$. The scheme $S_0$ is excellent Noetherian and finite-dimensional. If $q_0:S'_0\to S_0$ is a modification, the reduced closure $S'$ of its isomorphism open after base change to $S$ is a modification $q:S'\to S$ and maps to $S'_0$. For every integer $r$, $P_r((f_0)_{S'_0},(K_0)_{S'_0})$ implies $P_r(f_{S'},K_{S'})$, with $P_r$ and modification as in [def-trf-orgogozo-induction-data].
